title: Track plan
summary: The track plan shows the concrete tracks planned for the coming hours. The system builds it from the grid and keeps it 24 to 48 hours ahead.

entities.text: An hour whose tracks are chosen. It is rebuilt automatically when its clock or the grid changes.
An hour that is on air or about to start. Its first items are already sent to Liquidsoap, so it is not rebuilt.
Why an item is there: the clock, filler (pool, playlist, artist, random, or an answer to a reminder), or a rescheduled missed item.
A problem the engine found while planning, for example an element skipped because play rules blocked every track.

usage: Look ahead to check what will play. If something looks wrong, fix the clock, playlist, or rule, then rebuild the affected hours. The panel shows the plan; it never calculates it.
steps: Choose the hours to look at (up to 7 days).
Read the warnings of each hour.
Fix the cause on the Clocks, Playlists, or Play rules page.
Rebuild the range and follow the operation in the header.
mistakes: Trying to change the hour on air. Frozen hours keep their plan.
Rebuilding without fixing the cause. The same warning comes back.

example.title: A skipped jingle
example.text: Tomorrow 09:15 shows the warning "element skipped: blocked by play rules". Both jingles of "Jingles" are limited to 06:00 to 08:00 and 10:00 to 12:00. Add a jingle without a window to the playlist and rebuild tomorrow; the 09:15 slot is now filled.

operations.edit: A rebuild changes only planned items in hours that have not started.

from.label: From
from.text: First hour to show or rebuild, station time.

to.label: To
to.text: Last hour, at most 7 days after the first.
